ITEM 1 | Tan-brown rice-like mixture with small darker flecks and bits of golden-brown pieces, loose and grainy, mounded in the upper-left area of the plate, roughly 8 cm by 6 cm, about 2 cm tall, matte with slight moisture | 110
ITEM 2 | Cooked green beans, bright to dark green with some darker olive tones, thin whole pods 8-10 cm long, slightly glossy and limp, piled in a loose cluster on the upper-right of the plate, about 9 cm by 7 cm, about 2 cm tall | 85
ITEM 3 | Bone-in chicken drumstick piece with a golden-brown breaded or crispy coating, darker browned edges, meaty portion tapering to exposed pale bone tip at the left end, about 12 cm long and 5 cm wide, sitting on the plate center-left | 150
ITEM 4 | Rectangular slice of pizza-like baked item with pale melted cheese topped with red-orange sauce spots and browned blistered edges, slightly oily sheen, firm enough to hold shape, about 8 cm by 6 cm and 1.5 cm thick, lower-left of the plate | 110
